constraints: Without the trailing '*' parameter, an error is generated if a document already exists at destinationName; with '*', the existing document is silently deleted and overwritten.

To designate a folder rather than a file, both sourceName and destinationName must end with the platform folder separator; all intermediate folders in destinationName must already exist (they are not created).
newName only applies when copying a single file, to rename it at the destination; it is not used when copying a folder.

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Copies a file or folder from sourceName to destinationName, optionally renaming a copied file, optionally overwriting an existing destination document when '*' is passed.
